mapper.sql: FROM biz_group_participation_receipt receipt JOIN biz_payment payment ON payment.id = receipt.payment_id AND NOT payment.deleted AND payment.status = 'succeeded' LEFT JOIN biz_refund refund ON refund.payment_id = payment.id AND NOT refund.deleted WHERE receipt.outcome = 'compensation_required' AND NOT receipt.deleted AND (refund.status IS NULL OR refund.status != 'succeeded')
mapper.select:
WITH attention AS ( SELECT payment.id AS payment_id, payment.user_id, COALESCE(receipt.deal_id, CASE WHEN payment.operation = 'JOIN' THEN payment.business_id END) AS deal_id, receipt.reason_code, payment.amount, payment.currency, COALESCE(refund.status, 'pending') AS refund_status, receipt.create_time AS occurred_at
ORDER BY receipt.create_time DESC, payment.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) SELECT attention.payment_id, attention.user_id AS buyer_id, attention.deal_id, deal.deal_no, attention.reason_code, attention.amount, attention.currency, attention.refund_status, attention.occurred_at FROM attention LEFT JOIN biz_group_deal deal ON deal.id = attention.deal_id ORDER BY attention.occurred_at DESC, attention.payment_id DESC
